name: palshare-ui-ux
description: > **A Django-powered social platform built from the ground up — and then rebuilt from the inside out.** 💙 > > Palshare is a personal learning, engineering, and architecture journey: authentication, profiles, posts, media, follows, interactions, search, messaging, REST APIs, AI integration, weather integration, PostgreSQL, testing, and a deliberate refactoring effort to grow a once-centralized Django application into a clean domain-oriented platform.
